reviews.title: Fraud & nonfunctional app
reviews.text: When I first signed up I paid for a membership that I didn’t receive & had to email them for the access. Because of my bad experience they gave me lifetime access & asked me to delete my bad review. Not only does the app not function correctly for Apple Music but for more than 2 weeks they have been having ‘syncing issues’ so even if you’re paying you’re paying for nothing because there’s no accuracy. The worst part is they make it impossible for you to cancel your membership & remove your card information. My initial issue was in March & I asked for everything to be canceled & stopped. For whatever reason yesterday they charged my account 6 months later & i have searched the whole website for a way to get my card information off their site so they don’t charge me again & to get refunded since I didn’t renew any membership with them. This is a fraudulent & nonfunctional app, I would never recommend it.

reviews.title: Updates have broken the app
reviews.text:
Up until 3-4 months ago, I would’ve confidently rated the app a 5/5 stars. I really enjoy using it and found it reliable. Unfortunately, recent updates have significantly affected the accuracy of my statistics. 

For example, if I listen to a song once for four minutes, the app now shows it as four separate one minute streams. Songs that previously had 100+ streams are displaying as zero, whilst tracks I’ve never listened to are appearing at the top of my Lifetime Top Songs page. This makes the app feel unreliable, which is disappointing for an app centred around detailed listening stats. 

I understand the team is likely very busy, but I haven’t had any success contacting support about these issues, 6 weeks since my first email. It’s just a shame that a product many of us have paid for isn’t currently working as advertised. 

I really hope these issues can be resolved soon, as I’d love to return to giving this app a higher rating.

reviews.title: It just keeps getting worse
reviews.text:
This app is great for people wanting to look at their music stats, the statistics are super detailed and when the app works right it’s amazing. But this PAID app has been getting worse and worse since I started using it over a year ago. (it might be closer to two years actually). There are constantly issues with the data of albums and songs, the most recent one is that now, if an album has songs that were released as singles, it shows the stats of the single version of the song, not the one on the album. So songs that I’ve listened to upwards of 200 times now show that I’ve actually only listened to them like 7 times, or sometimes not at all! 

Also, reporting bugs on this app is a complete nightmare. If you report them on the app itself, support will tell you to contact the support via email. And then when you contact them via email, they’ll tell you, “Huh that’s a weird glitch, make sure you contact the support through the app.” So which is it? And stuff that I’ve reported as being obvious bugs (the timestamp of a song being 0:30 instead of 10:30 for example) months ago have never been fixed. I wouldn’t care about all this if the app was completely free, but it’s not. If you want any in depth stats you HAVE to pay.

reviews.title: Used to be great, not anymore
reviews.text: This app used to be good but now it’s overrun with so many ads that make the app lag and hard to use. I never had an issue just using the free version and was okay that certain features were off limits, but now it seems difficult to access even the free version. There’s an ads in between every 3 tracks and they make scrolling and going in between tracks, artists and albums so laggy. Definitely not user friendly and no point in having the app anymore.

reviews.title: Cool idea, too many ads
reviews.text:
This is genuinely a really cool idea and exactly the sort of app I’d normally be interested in using. The concept is strong and it looks great visually.

However, I struggle to see enough value to justify the premium subscription in its current form. Within the first minute of using it, I was prompted multiple times to upgrade, and I had to sit through two ads almost immediately. There were also ads placed throughout the stats screens, which made the experience feel quite cluttered.

I only spent about 45 seconds in the app before deciding to delete it, which is a shame because the core idea has real potential. If the value offering was clearer and the upselling less aggressive, I think more people would be willing to stick around and explore it properly.

It definitely has promise, but the balance between value and monetisation needs some work.

reviews.title: Love the concept, WAY too many ads
reviews.text: I’ve had this app for a while now, and I think it’s a fun concept to see what I’ve been listening to throughout the year before getting my wrapped, but there are way too many ads, to the point where the app lags out and is literally impossible to use now. I get it, you need to make a profit, but if users can’t use the app, you lose a bigger profit in lack of credibility and actual app usage than what you’re getting from the ads. I don’t mind an occasional pop up if I’ve been idle for a while, but it’s constant. Opening the app; ad. Swapping through artists and track stats; ad. I can barely scroll because the app lags so bad from how many ads there are over my screen. This is an app, not an internet browser. My app shouldn’t be freaking out because I’m getting four of the same pop ups all running the same minute ad.
